query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Rivenhall . Does every Rivenhall listing stock the 2 x 9.5L pack? Answer yes or no.

Before answering, open every listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check the relevant option on each one. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

result.final: No. Not every Rivenhall listing stocks the 2 x 9.5L pack. I opened and checked all 15 Rivenhall listings in the search results. 10 listings have the 2 x 9.5L pack option available, while 5 listings do not have this option. The listings WITHOUT the 2 x 9.5L option are: Chandler Wholesale, Pembroke Trading, Stonebridge Trading, Whitlock Provisions, and Oakfield Wholesale.
